Operator Guide • v0.15.0 • Inbox Attach + PDF Wedge

IronLedger Operator Guide & Reference

IronLedger is a local-first financial OS. Plaintext Beancount is accounting authority; SQLite is a disposable projection. Phase 15 treats a later statement row as more evidence on an existing economic event. Confirm attach. Do not create a second posting.

v0.15.0 — what changed

  • Inbox can show attach and near-miss proposals next to ordinary pending rows.
  • PDF bank/card statements (text layer) import through --pdf-profile. Inbox suffixes: .csv .ofx .qfx .pdf.
  • Confirm writes event_evidence. Staged/ledger posting count does not increase. Payee and narration on the target stay put.
  • Never auto-attach. Enter / Approve skip attach rows. Pick a candidate, then Confirm attach.
  • SimpleFIN ingest is a match target only. It is not rerouted through run_import.
  • OCR, email, XLS, Zapier, NotebookLM, and OAuth are out of this slice.
Diataxis 1

Quickstart Tutorial

1. Ingest Statement Records

CSV / OFX / QFX rows become staged events. Those events are later attach targets.

python -m ironledger.cli import inbox/checking_export.ofx --confirm "import inbox/checking_export.ofx"

The confirm phrase is import <resolved-path>. Use the path the CLI resolved, not a nickname.

2. Import a PDF Statement

Text-layer PDF only. The shipped wedge profile is example-card (Liabilities:CreditCard:ExampleCard, sign as_printed, ±3 calendar days). Do not pass --importing-account when the profile already sets the account.

python -m ironledger.cli import inbox/card-statement.pdf --pdf-profile example-card --confirm "import inbox/card-statement.pdf"

3. Confirm Attach

Open the workbench. Attach rows are badged attach or near-miss. In the inspector, choose a candidate radio (none is preselected) and click Confirm attach. Enter and Approve do nothing on these rows.

python -m ironledger.cli web --port 8000
python -m ironledger.cli review attach-confirm PROP_ID --chosen STAGED_ID --confirm "attach-confirm PROP_ID"

4. Review Remaining Pending

Unmatched PDF rows land as ordinary pending inbox items. Categorize and approve those as before. Rejected attach proposals do not attach evidence.

python -m ironledger.cli review attach-reject PROP_ID --confirm "attach-reject PROP_ID"
python -m ironledger.cli review list --status pending
Diataxis 2

How-To Guides

How to Attach Later Evidence to an Existing Charge

  • Import a later CSV/OFX/PDF. Matching rows become attach_proposals, not a second staged posting pair.
  • Match key is imported-leg minor_units + account + currency + integer calendar-day window. Payee is enrichment, not identity.
  • Unique window hit still requires confirm. Two same-amount hits in the window: disambiguate; no default selected.
  • Two rows from one source document cannot attach to the same event.
  • Amount+account hits outside the window, or with flipped sign, surface as near-miss suggestions.
  • Confirm writes event_evidence and leaves the target identity_fingerprint, payee, and narration unchanged.
  • Same content-hash reimport short-circuits when source rows already have staged txns or pending/confirmed proposals.

How to Import a Text-Layer PDF Statement

  • Put a profile JSON in config/pdf-profiles/<name>.json. Pass --pdf-profile <name>.
  • Shipped profile: example-card. Account Liabilities:CreditCard:ExampleCard. sign is as_printed or invert. Default window is 3 days.
  • Parser reads the PDF text layer via pypdf. Empty text (scans without OCR) fails closed. OCR is not in this slice.
  • --pdf-profile is required for .pdf and rejected for CSV.

How to Tell Staging Rows from Attach Rows

  • Ordinary staged rows: Enter / a approve, x reject, inspector categorizes the contra account.
  • Attach rows (item_type = attach): inspector lists candidate radios. Confirm attach stays disabled until you pick one.
  • Enter / Approve on an attach row is a no-op. That is intentional (false-attach guard).
  • x on an attach row rejects the proposal. It does not approve a posting.

How to Manage Multi-Asset Holdings & Watchlist Pricing

  • Watchlist Guard: In the Workbench Holdings & Watchlist view, click the Lock Guard button to toggle edit mode before adding or removing symbols.
  • Add Symbols: Supply base symbol (e.g. NVDA), quote currency (USD), and optional fallback price.
  • Remove Symbols: Click the trash button on any unlocked symbol row, or delete from config/prices.json.
  • On-Demand Sync: Click Sync Watchlist to scrape live quotes and refresh valuation tables.

How to Inspect Cash Flow Sankey Diagrams

The Sankey visualizer renders directed cash flow linkages from Income accounts through Operating Buffer to Expenses and Asset allocations for any YYYY-MM period.

How to Generate and Verify Compliance Audit Bundles

python -m ironledger.cli compliance generate --ledger-id default --framework SOC2_TYPE2 --out bundle.tar
python -m ironledger.cli compliance verify --bundle bundle.tar

Technical Reference

REST API Catalog

Attach mutations require header X-IronLedger-Op-Token when an operator token is configured.

MethodEndpointDescription
GET/api/staging/proposalsList pending attach proposals
POST/api/staging/proposals/{id}/confirmBody {"chosen_staged_id": "..."}. Writes event_evidence. No new posting.
POST/api/staging/proposals/{id}/rejectReject an attach proposal
GET/api/analytics/watchlistList active watchlist commodities and prices
POST/api/analytics/watchlist/addAdd symbol to config/prices.json
DELETE/api/analytics/watchlist/{symbol}Remove symbol from watchlist
POST/api/analytics/prices/syncTrigger on-demand feed scraping
GET/api/analytics/portfolioConsolidated multi-asset holdings & P&L
GET/api/analytics/sankey?period=YYYY-MMDirected cash flow link matrix

CLI Command Matrix

python -m ironledger.cli web --port 8000
python -m ironledger.cli import inbox/file.ofx --confirm "import <resolved-path>"
python -m ironledger.cli import inbox/card.pdf --pdf-profile example-card --confirm "import <resolved-path>"
python -m ironledger.cli review attach-confirm PROP_ID --chosen STAGED_ID --confirm "attach-confirm PROP_ID"
python -m ironledger.cli review attach-reject PROP_ID --confirm "attach-reject PROP_ID"
python -m ironledger.cli prices poll --ledger-id default
python -m ironledger.cli prices sync --symbols AAPL MSFT BTC
python -m ironledger.cli compile --dry-run
python -m ironledger.cli compile --confirm "authorize compile"

Keyboard Shortcuts

j Next row
k Previous row
a Approve staged (no-op on attach)
Enter Approve staged (no-op on attach)
x Reject staged or attach proposal
Ctrl+K Command Palette
Ctrl+R Rule Wizard
Ctrl+S Simulate
Ctrl+Enter Compile

Attach confirm is not a shortcut. Choose a candidate in the inspector, then click Confirm attach.

Diataxis 4

Architecture & Invariants

Evidence-Linked Identity

Identity v1 is FITID (if trusted) or SHA-256 of account+date+amount+currency+payee+institution. That fingerprint still dedupes inserts. Phase 15 adds a join: many source_records can hang off one economic event via event_evidence. A later PDF row is more evidence, not a new charge.

Attach Match Key

Candidates are imported legs on existing staged transactions: exact minor_units, same account, same currency, date within the profile’s integer day window. Payee is not in the match key. Unique hits still wait for an operator. Ambiguous windows never auto-attach. SimpleFIN remains on ingest_simplefin_payload; it is a match target, not an attach adapter.

Zero-Float Exact Rational Arithmetic

Enforced by static AST verification: zero ast.Div and zero runtime import beancount on the new ingest modules. Amounts stay integer minor units. PDF sign is as_printed or invert — never a float flip.
